reading.zh: 应用起窗，外壳摆好三栏；编辑由步骤视图模型与契约驱动的参数界面完成；取区域与回放都通过桥接走常驻 Runner（命名管道）。编辑器自己不认识流程格式细节，也不重做选区与回放——字段与文案都来自契约。
reading.en: App starts the window, the shell lays out three panes, the step view model and the contract-driven inspector do the editing, and both region picking and replay go through the bridge to the resident Runner over the named pipe. The editor re-implements neither picking nor replay; the schema (and the messages) come from the capability layer.
